evidence.title: 15-year-old arrested after attack at Polish school that left 1 dead, 2 wounded

occurrences.checkable_against: Polish police incident and custody records for the northern Poland vocational school attack
occurrences.quote_span: The violence occurred a day after a 19-year-old student at a vocational school in northern Poland attacked fellow students, teachers and passersby with a sharp object, wounding eight people before fleeing and being taken into custody nearby.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

evidence.title: Polish police arrest man after school attack injured 9 people

occurrences.checkable_against: Regional government and hospital casualty records for the Ostroleka attack
occurrences.quote_span: Five students, two teachers and two passersby were injured, regional Gov. Mariusz Frankowski said.
occurrences.speaker: Mariusz Frankowski
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Polish police incident and arrest records for the Ostroleka school attack
occurrences.quote_span: A 19-year-old student at a vocational school in northern Poland attacked fellow students, teachers and passersby with a sharp object Wednesday, injuring nine people before fleeing and being arrested nearby, authorities said.
occurrences.speaker: authorities
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Polish police incident report for the Vocational School Complex No. 4 attack
occurrences.quote_span: The attack took place about 11 a.m. local time at the Vocational School Complex No. 4 in Ostroleka, about 120 kilometers (75 miles) northeast of Warsaw, police said.
occurrences.speaker: police
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Polish police arrest report and location records
occurrences.quote_span: He was arrested on a riverbank less than 1 kilometer (a half mile) from the school after fleeing the scene, according to police.
occurrences.speaker: police
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Polish police prior-contact and narcotics-possession records
occurrences.quote_span: Police said the suspect had previously come to their attention over the possession of a small amount of narcotics.
occurrences.speaker: police
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Ostroleka mayor's social-media post and school closure records
occurrences.quote_span: Two hours after the attack, Ostroleka Mayor Paweł Niewiadomski wrote on social media that the “situation has been brought under control” but that the school would remain closed while authorities investigate the circumstances of the attack.
occurrences.speaker: Paweł Niewiadomski
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Hospital admission records and police custody records
occurrences.quote_span: The young man was taken to a hospital.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Polish police identification records and privacy-law reporting restrictions
occurrences.quote_span: Authorities identified the suspect only as Jakub Z., in line with Polish privacy laws.
occurrences.speaker: authorities
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Prosecutors' statements and suspect medical records
occurrences.quote_span: He was wounded at the time of his arrest in what prosecutors said was a result of “self-mutilation.”
occurrences.speaker: prosecutors
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Mayor's social-media statement and regional school security directives
occurrences.quote_span: He said kids and others affected would receive psychological support and that he had asked all schools in the region to ban any unknown people from entering their premises.
occurrences.speaker: Paweł Niewiadomski
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Official statements by Polish authorities about the attack motive and weapon
occurrences.quote_span: Authorities did not provide any information about the suspected motive, or details about the weapon.
occurrences.speaker: authorities
occurrences.subject: Ostroleka vocational school attack

occurrences.checkable_against: Fire department incident report and investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: A spokesman for the local firefighters told Polsat television that a suspicious backpack was found in the school and that authorities were investigating its contents.
